continent.en: Africa is the second largest continent in the world by area.
continent.zh: 按面积计算,非洲是世界第二大洲。

hemisphere.en: Summer in one hemisphere occurs at the same time as winter in the other.
hemisphere.zh: 一个半球的夏季与另一个半球的冬季同时出现。

equator.en: Temperatures near the equator remain high throughout most of the year.
equator.zh: 赤道附近的气温全年大部分时间都很高。

latitude.en: Temperatures generally fall as latitude increases, although mountains can alter this pattern.
latitude.zh: 气温通常随纬度升高而下降,不过山脉可能改变这一规律。

longitude.en: Accurate clocks allowed sailors to calculate their longitude while at sea.
longitude.zh: 精确的时钟让水手能够在海上计算所处的经度。

altitude.en: Breathing becomes more difficult at high altitude because the air is thin.
altitude.zh: 在高海拔地区,空气稀薄,呼吸变得更困难。

elevation.en: This type of pine tree grows only at an elevation above two thousand metres.
elevation.zh: 这种松树只生长在海拔两千米以上的地方。

terrain.en: The rocky terrain made it very difficult to build roads through the region.
terrain.zh: 岩石嶙峋的地形使这一地区很难修路。

landscape.en: Ice sheets shaped much of the landscape of northern Europe.
landscape.zh: 冰盖塑造了北欧的大部分地貌。

topography.en: The topography of the area affects where rain falls and rivers flow.
topography.zh: 这一地区的地形影响着降雨的位置和河流的走向。

plain.en: Huge herds of animals once moved across the open plains of North America.
plain.zh: 曾有大群动物在北美开阔的平原上迁徙。

plain.en: It is plain from the records that the river has changed course several times.
plain.zh: 从记录中可以清楚地看出,这条河曾多次改道。

valley.en: Early farmers settled in the valley because the soil there was rich.
valley.zh: 早期农民定居在这个山谷,因为那里土壤肥沃。

canyon.en: Over millions of years, the river cut a deep canyon through the rock.
canyon.zh: 数百万年间,这条河在岩石中切割出一道深深的大峡谷。

gorge.en: The road follows a narrow gorge between two high walls of rock.
gorge.zh: 这条路沿着两面高耸岩壁之间的狭窄峡谷延伸。

cliff.en: Thousands of sea birds nest on the cliffs along this coast.
cliff.zh: 数千只海鸟在这段海岸的悬崖上筑巢。

slope.en: Tea grows well on the steep slopes of the mountains in this region.
slope.zh: 茶树在这一地区陡峭的山坡上长得很好。

ridge.en: A long ridge of hills separates the wet coast from the dry interior.
ridge.zh: 一道绵长的山脊把潮湿的海岸和干燥的内陆隔开。

summit.en: The climbers reached the summit of the mountain just after sunrise.
summit.zh: 登山者在日出后不久到达了山顶。

summit.en: World leaders met at a summit to discuss the reduction of carbon emissions.
summit.zh: 世界各国领导人在峰会上讨论减少碳排放的问题。

volcano.en: The volcano last erupted about four hundred years ago.
volcano.zh: 这座火山最后一次喷发是在大约四百年前。

crater.en: The lake was formed when rain filled the crater of an old volcano.
crater.zh: 雨水注满一座古火山的火山口,形成了这个湖。

lava.en: Hot lava flowed down the mountain and destroyed several small villages.
lava.zh: 炽热的熔岩从山上流下,摧毁了几个小村庄。

magma.en: Volcanoes form when magma rises through cracks in the Earth's surface.
magma.zh: 岩浆穿过地表裂缝上升时就形成了火山。

eruption.en: Ash from the eruption blocked out the sun for several days.
eruption.zh: 喷发产生的火山灰遮蔽了太阳好几天。

earthquake.en: The earthquake damaged most of the older buildings in the city centre.
earthquake.zh: 这场地震损坏了市中心的大部分老建筑。

seismic.en: Seismic activity in the area has increased over the past few months.
seismic.zh: 过去几个月,该地区的地震活动有所增加。

tectonic-plate.en: Mountains often form where one tectonic plate pushes against another.
tectonic-plate.zh: 山脉常常在一个构造板块挤压另一个板块的地方形成。

crust.en: The Earth's crust is thinnest beneath the oceans.

mantle.en: Heat from the mantle slowly moves the plates on the Earth's surface.
mantle.zh: 来自地幔的热量缓慢推动地球表面的板块移动。

core.en: Scientists believe that the Earth's core is made mainly of iron.
core.zh: 科学家认为地核主要由铁构成。

core.en: Trust lies at the core of any healthy community.
core.zh: 信任是任何健康社区的核心。

fault.en: Most of the region's earthquakes occur along a major fault in the rock.
fault.zh: 该地区的大多数地震发生在岩石中的一条主要断层沿线。

glacier.en: The glacier has moved back by more than a kilometre since 1950.
glacier.zh: 自 1950 年以来,这条冰川已经后退了一公里多。

iceberg.en: Most of an iceberg's mass lies hidden beneath the surface of the water.
iceberg.zh: 冰山的大部分质量隐藏在水面以下。

ice-sheet.en: If the ice sheet melted completely, sea levels would rise dramatically.
ice-sheet.zh: 如果冰盖完全融化,海平面将急剧上升。

polar.en: Polar bears depend on sea ice for hunting seals.
polar.zh: 北极熊依靠海冰来捕猎海豹。

arctic.en: The Arctic is warming faster than almost any other part of the world.
arctic.zh: 北极变暖的速度几乎比世界其他任何地方都快。

antarctic.en: Few plants can survive in the freezing Antarctic climate.
antarctic.zh: 很少有植物能在严寒的南极气候中存活。

tundra.en: Only small plants and mosses can grow on the frozen tundra.
tundra.zh: 冰冻的苔原上只能生长矮小的植物和苔藓。

desert.en: The desert receives less than ten centimetres of rain each year.
desert.zh: 这片沙漠每年的降雨量不到十厘米。

dune.en: Strong winds cause the sand dunes to move slowly across the land.
dune.zh: 强风使沙丘在地面上缓慢移动。

oasis.en: Travellers crossing the desert stopped at the oasis for water and shade.
oasis.zh: 穿越沙漠的旅行者在绿洲停下来取水和乘凉。

savanna.en: Large herds of grazing animals move across the savanna in search of fresh grass.
savanna.zh: 大群食草动物穿越热带草原,寻找新鲜的青草。

prairie.en: Much of the original prairie has now been turned into wheat fields.
prairie.zh: 大部分原始草原如今已变成麦田。

grassland.en: Overgrazing has turned large areas of grassland into dry, bare ground.
grassland.zh: 过度放牧使大片草原变成了干燥裸露的土地。

rainforest.en: The rainforest is home to millions of species of plants and insects.
rainforest.zh: 雨林是数百万种植物和昆虫的家园。

wetland.en: Wetlands act as natural filters that clean water before it reaches the sea.
wetland.zh: 湿地就像天然过滤器,在水流入海洋前将其净化。

marsh.en: Reeds and tall grasses grow thickly in the marsh beside the river.
marsh.zh: 河边的沼泽里长满了芦苇和高草。

swamp.en: Crocodiles and many kinds of snakes live in the swamp.
swamp.zh: 沼泽里生活着鳄鱼和多种蛇。

delta.en: The river deposits rich soil as it reaches the delta.
delta.zh: 河流到达三角洲时沉积下肥沃的土壤。

estuary.en: Salt water and fresh water mix in the estuary of the river.
estuary.zh: 咸水和淡水在河口交汇。

basin.en: The Amazon basin contains the largest rainforest on the planet.
basin.zh: 亚马孙流域拥有地球上最大的雨林。

tributary.en: Several small tributaries join the main river before it reaches the plain.
tributary.zh: 几条小支流在到达平原之前汇入干流。

reservoir.en: The reservoir supplies drinking water to more than a million people.
reservoir.zh: 这座水库为一百多万人提供饮用水。

waterfall.en: The waterfall drops nearly a hundred metres into the valley below.
waterfall.zh: 瀑布落差近一百米,直泻下方的山谷。

spring.en: Local people have drawn fresh water from this spring for centuries.
spring.zh: 几个世纪以来,当地人一直从这眼泉取用淡水。

peninsula.en: The peninsula is surrounded by the sea on three sides.

archipelago.en: The archipelago consists of more than a thousand small islands.
archipelago.zh: 这个群岛由一千多个小岛组成。

coastline.en: Rising seas are slowly changing the shape of the country's coastline.
coastline.zh: 不断上升的海平面正慢慢改变该国海岸线的形状。

shore.en: Many turtles return to the same shore each year to lay their eggs.
shore.zh: 许多海龟每年回到同一片海岸产卵。

bay.en: Ships shelter in the bay when storms come in from the ocean.
bay.zh: 海上风暴来袭时,船只在海湾里避风。

gulf.en: The oil spill spread across a large part of the gulf.
gulf.zh: 石油泄漏扩散到了这片海湾的大部分区域。

gulf.en: There is a wide gulf between the rich and the poor in the region.
gulf.zh: 该地区贫富之间存在巨大的鸿沟。

strait.en: Thousands of ships pass through this narrow strait each year.
strait.zh: 每年有数千艘船只通过这条狭窄的海峡。

cave.en: Paintings found in the cave are more than thirty thousand years old.
cave.zh: 在这个洞穴里发现的壁画已有三万多年历史。

sediment.en: Over time, layers of sediment collect at the bottom of the lake.
sediment.zh: 随着时间推移,一层层沉积物堆积在湖底。

sedimentary.en: Fossils are most commonly found in sedimentary rocks such as limestone.
sedimentary.zh: 化石最常见于石灰岩等沉积岩中。

erosion.en: Tree roots help to prevent soil erosion on steep hillsides.
erosion.zh: 树根有助于防止陡峭山坡上的水土流失。

erode.en: Waves continue to erode the cliffs at a rate of one metre a year.
erode.zh: 海浪持续侵蚀悬崖,速度为每年一米。

weathering.en: Weathering by wind and rain slowly breaks down even the hardest rock.
weathering.zh: 风雨的风化作用能慢慢分解最坚硬的岩石。

mineral.en: Plants take up water and minerals from the soil through their roots.
mineral.zh: 植物通过根部从土壤中吸收水分和矿物质。

ore.en: The iron ore is transported by train to the port for export.
ore.zh: 铁矿石用火车运到港口出口。

granite.en: Granite is a very hard rock that was often used for building.
granite.zh: 花岗岩是一种非常坚硬的岩石,常被用于建筑。

limestone.en: Rainwater slowly dissolves limestone, creating large underground caves.
limestone.zh: 雨水慢慢溶解石灰岩,形成巨大的地下洞穴。

sandstone.en: The red cliffs are made of sandstone laid down millions of years ago.
sandstone.zh: 这些红色悬崖由数百万年前沉积的砂岩构成。

fossil.en: The fossil of a large sea animal was found high in the mountains.
fossil.zh: 在高山上发现了一种大型海洋动物的化石。

geology.en: Students of geology spend a lot of time looking closely at rocks.
geology.zh: 学习地质学的学生要花很多时间仔细观察岩石。

geography.en: The geography of the island has shaped its culture and its economy.
geography.zh: 这座岛的地理环境塑造了它的文化和经济。

region.en: This region of the country produces most of its wine.
region.zh: 该国这一地区出产该国大部分葡萄酒。

horizon.en: Sailors watched the land slowly disappear below the horizon.
horizon.zh: 水手们看着陆地慢慢消失在地平线下。

contour.en: The contour lines on the map show how steeply the land rises.
contour.zh: 从地图上的等高线可以看出地势升得有多陡。

highland.en: Sheep farming has long been the main activity in the highland areas.
highland.zh: 长期以来,养羊一直是高地地区的主要活动。

lowland.en: Rice grows best in lowland areas that flood during the wet season.
lowland.zh: 水稻最适合生长在雨季会被淹没的低地。

meadow.en: Wild flowers cover the mountain meadows in early summer.
meadow.zh: 初夏时节,野花开满了高山草地。

jungle.en: The ruins of the ancient city were hidden in the jungle for centuries.
jungle.zh: 这座古城的遗迹在丛林中隐藏了几个世纪。

scenery.en: The region's beautiful scenery attracts thousands of walkers each summer.
scenery.zh: 该地区美丽的风景每年夏天吸引数千名徒步者。

spectacle.en: The migration of the birds across the lake is an amazing spectacle.
spectacle.zh: 鸟群飞越湖面的迁徙是一幅令人惊叹的壮观景象。

cavern.en: The underground river opens into a huge cavern filled with stone columns.
cavern.zh: 这条地下河通向一个布满石柱的巨大洞穴。

crevice.en: Small lizards hide in the crevices between the rocks during the day.
crevice.zh: 小蜥蜴白天躲在岩石之间的裂缝里。

chasm.en: The earthquake opened a deep chasm across the floor of the valley.
chasm.zh: 地震在山谷底部撕开了一道深深的裂口。

ledge.en: The birds lay their eggs on a narrow ledge high on the cliff.
ledge.zh: 这些鸟把蛋产在悬崖高处狭窄的岩架上。

terrestrial.en: Whales evolved from terrestrial animals that returned to the sea.
terrestrial.zh: 鲸是由重返海洋的陆地动物进化而来的。

subterranean.en: Blind fish live in the dark waters of these subterranean lakes.
subterranean.zh: 失明的鱼生活在这些地下湖的黑暗水域中。

groundwater.en: Farmers are pumping groundwater faster than it can be replaced by rain.
groundwater.zh: 农民抽取地下水的速度超过了雨水补充的速度。

offshore.en: Offshore wind farms can produce more power than those built on land.
offshore.zh: 近海风电场的发电量可能超过陆上风电场。

islet.en: Seals rest on a small rocky islet just off the coast.
islet.zh: 海豹在离岸不远的一个多岩石的小岛上休息。

insular.en: The island's insular position protected it from many of the mainland's diseases.
insular.zh: 这座岛的海岛位置使它免受大陆上许多疾病的侵袭。

tropics.en: Many diseases spread by insects are common in the tropics.
tropics.zh: 许多由昆虫传播的疾病在热带地区很常见。

meridian.en: The meridian passing through Greenwich marks zero degrees of longitude.
meridian.zh: 穿过格林尼治的子午线标志着零度经线。

alpine.en: Alpine plants have adapted to cold temperatures and strong winds.
alpine.zh: 高山植物已适应低温和强风。

avalanche.en: Heavy snowfall increases the risk of an avalanche on steep mountain slopes.
avalanche.zh: 大雪增加了陡峭山坡上发生雪崩的风险。

crevasse.en: The climbers used ladders to cross a deep crevasse in the glacier.
crevasse.zh: 登山者用梯子越过冰川上一道深深的冰隙。

stratum.en: Each stratum of rock contains clues about conditions at a particular time.
stratum.zh: 每一层岩层都包含着某一时期环境的线索。

layer.en: A thick layer of ash covered the town after the volcano erupted.
layer.zh: 火山喷发后,厚厚一层火山灰覆盖了小镇。

lithosphere.en: The lithosphere is broken into large plates that move very slowly.
lithosphere.zh: 岩石圈分裂成几大板块,这些板块移动得非常缓慢。

formation.en: The formation of these rocks took place over millions of years.
formation.zh: 这些岩石的形成历经数百万年。

tremor.en: Local people felt a slight tremor several hours before the main earthquake.
tremor.zh: 主震发生前几小时,当地人感觉到了轻微的震动。

magnitude.en: An earthquake of this magnitude can destroy buildings within seconds.
magnitude.zh: 这种震级的地震能在几秒钟内摧毁建筑物。

seismology.en: Advances in seismology have made it easier to locate the centre of an earthquake.
seismology.zh: 地震学的进步使确定地震中心变得更容易。

volcanic.en: Volcanic soils are often very rich and good for growing crops.
volcanic.zh: 火山土壤往往非常肥沃,适合种植庄稼。

erupt.en: Scientists cannot say exactly when the volcano will erupt again.
erupt.zh: 科学家无法确切地说出这座火山何时会再次喷发。

thermal.en: Iceland uses thermal energy from under the ground to heat many of its homes.
thermal.zh: 冰岛利用地下热能为许多家庭供暖。

quartz.en: Quartz is one of the most common minerals found in the Earth's crust.
quartz.zh: 石英是地壳中最常见的矿物之一。

marble.en: The ancient Greeks used white marble for many of their finest buildings.
marble.zh: 古希腊人用白色大理石建造了许多最精美的建筑。

gem.en: Traders carried gems and spices along the old routes through the mountains.
gem.zh: 商人们带着宝石和香料,沿着穿越山脉的古道前行。

northern-hemisphere.en: Most of the world's land lies in the northern hemisphere.
northern-hemisphere.zh: 世界上大部分陆地位于北半球。

southern-hemisphere.en: Birds from Europe spend the winter months in the southern hemisphere.
southern-hemisphere.zh: 来自欧洲的鸟在南半球度过冬季。

arctic-circle.en: The sun does not set for weeks in the summer above the Arctic Circle.
arctic-circle.zh: 夏季,北极圈以北的太阳数周不落。

gradient.en: The railway could not be built on such a steep gradient.
gradient.zh: 这么陡的坡度上无法修建铁路。

watershed.en: The mountains form a watershed between rivers flowing east and those flowing west.
watershed.zh: 这些山脉构成了东流河与西流河之间的分水岭。

watershed.en: The invention of the steam engine was a watershed in human history.
watershed.zh: 蒸汽机的发明是人类历史的转折点。

incline.en: The tracks follow a gentle incline up the side of the valley.
incline.zh: 铁轨沿着山谷一侧的缓坡向上延伸。

incline.en: Most experts incline to the view that the climate was the main cause.
incline.zh: 大多数专家倾向于认为气候是主要原因。

uplift.en: The mountains were formed by the slow uplift of the land.
uplift.zh: 这些山脉是由陆地的缓慢抬升形成的。

inland.en: Rain clouds rarely reach the dry inland areas of the continent.
inland.zh: 雨云很少能到达这片大陆干燥的内陆地区。

inland.en: The town now lies ten kilometres inland because the coast has moved.
inland.zh: 由于海岸线变化,这个小镇现在位于内陆十公里处。

wilderness.en: Large parts of the northern wilderness are still untouched by humans.
wilderness.zh: 北部荒野的大部分地区仍未被人类涉足。

quarry.en: Stone for the cathedral was brought from a quarry about ten miles away.
quarry.zh: 建造大教堂的石料来自约十英里外的一个采石场。

gravel.en: The river has left thick beds of sand and gravel across the plain.
gravel.zh: 河流在平原上留下了厚厚的沙层和砾石层。

dust.en: Clouds of dust from the Sahara can travel thousands of kilometres.
dust.zh: 来自撒哈拉的尘埃云能飘行数千公里。

descent.en: The descent into the valley took the explorers more than two days.
descent.zh: 探险家们下到山谷花了两天多时间。

descent.en: Many people in the town are of Italian descent.
descent.zh: 镇上许多人是意大利血统。

cape.en: Sailing around the cape was one of the most dangerous parts of the voyage.
cape.zh: 绕过这个海角是航程中最危险的部分之一。

verge.en: Rare wild flowers can sometimes be found growing on the verge of the road.
verge.zh: 有时能在路边发现生长着的珍稀野花。

climate.en: The climate of the region has become much drier over the past century.
climate.zh: 过去一个世纪,这一地区的气候变得干燥多了。

meteorology.en: Advances in meteorology have made it possible to warn people about storms.
meteorology.zh: 气象学的进步使人们能够提前预警风暴。

atmosphere.en: Carbon dioxide traps heat in the atmosphere and warms the planet.
atmosphere.zh: 二氧化碳把热量困在大气中,使地球变暖。

atmosphere.en: The old market has a lively atmosphere that attracts many visitors.
atmosphere.zh: 这个老市场氛围热闹,吸引了许多游客。

temperature.en: The average temperature on the island is about twenty degrees.
temperature.zh: 这座岛的平均气温约为二十度。

humidity.en: High humidity makes hot weather feel even more uncomfortable.
humidity.zh: 高湿度让炎热的天气感觉更不舒服。

humid.en: The humid conditions in the forest are ideal for the growth of fungi.
humid.zh: 森林里潮湿闷热的环境非常适合真菌生长。

arid.en: Very few people live in the arid regions of central Australia.
arid.zh: 澳大利亚中部的干旱地区人烟稀少。

tropical.en: Tropical storms cause serious damage to crops along this coast.
tropical.zh: 热带风暴给这段海岸的庄稼造成严重损害。

temperate.en: Oak and beech trees are common in temperate forests.
temperate.zh: 橡树和山毛榉在温带森林中很常见。

mediterranean.en: Olives and grapes grow well in a Mediterranean climate with dry summers.
mediterranean.zh: 橄榄和葡萄在夏季干燥的地中海气候中长得很好。

monsoon.en: Farmers in the region depend on the summer monsoon for their water.
monsoon.zh: 该地区的农民依靠夏季季风带来的水。

precipitation.en: Precipitation in the mountains falls mainly as snow in winter.
precipitation.zh: 山区的降水在冬季主要以雪的形式出现。

rainfall.en: Annual rainfall has dropped by nearly a third in the past fifty years.
rainfall.zh: 过去五十年,年降雨量下降了近三分之一。

drought.en: A long drought forced farmers to sell most of their cattle.
drought.zh: 长期干旱迫使农民卖掉了大部分牛。

flood.en: The flood destroyed roads and bridges throughout the northern part of the country.
flood.zh: 洪水摧毁了该国北部各地的道路和桥梁。

hurricane.en: The hurricane caused severe damage along the Atlantic coast.
hurricane.zh: 飓风在大西洋沿岸造成了严重破坏。

typhoon.en: More than a million people were moved to safety before the typhoon arrived.
typhoon.zh: 台风来临之前,有一百多万人被转移到安全地带。

cyclone.en: The cyclone brought strong winds and heavy rain to the islands.
cyclone.zh: 气旋给这些岛屿带来了强风和暴雨。

tornado.en: A tornado can destroy a house in a matter of seconds.
tornado.zh: 龙卷风能在几秒钟内摧毁一座房子。

blizzard.en: The blizzard left many remote villages without power for several days.
blizzard.zh: 这场暴风雪使许多偏远村庄断电数日。

thunderstorm.en: A sudden thunderstorm can cause dangerous flooding in narrow valleys.
thunderstorm.zh: 突如其来的雷暴可能在狭窄的山谷中引发危险的洪水。

lightning.en: Forest fires are sometimes started by lightning during the dry season.
lightning.zh: 旱季时,森林火灾有时是由闪电引发的。

hail.en: Large pieces of hail damaged the fruit crop in the valley.
hail.zh: 大块冰雹损坏了山谷里的水果作物。

frost.en: A late frost can kill young plants in the spring.
frost.zh: 春季晚霜可能冻死幼苗。

fog.en: Thick fog often covers the coast during the early morning.
fog.zh: 清晨时分,海岸常常被浓雾笼罩。

breeze.en: A cool breeze from the sea keeps the town comfortable in summer.
breeze.zh: 夏天来自海上的凉爽微风让小镇很舒适。

gust.en: A sudden gust of wind can make it hard for birds to land.
gust.zh: 一阵突如其来的强风会让鸟难以落地。

current.en: Warm ocean currents keep the coast free of ice during winter.
current.zh: 温暖的洋流使海岸在冬季不结冰。

current.en: Current methods of farming may not be able to feed the future population.
current.zh: 目前的耕作方法可能无法养活未来的人口。

el-nino.en: El Niño can bring heavy rain to parts of South America.
el-nino.zh: 厄尔尼诺可能给南美部分地区带来暴雨。

global-warming.en: Global warming is causing many species to move towards cooler areas.
global-warming.zh: 全球变暖正使许多物种向较凉爽的地区迁移。

greenhouse-effect.en: The greenhouse effect keeps the Earth warm enough for life to exist.
greenhouse-effect.zh: 温室效应使地球保持足够的温度,让生命得以存在。

ozone-layer.en: The ozone layer protects life on Earth from harmful radiation from the sun.
ozone-layer.zh: 臭氧层保护地球上的生命免受太阳有害辐射的伤害。

carbon-dioxide.en: Forests absorb large amounts of carbon dioxide from the air.
carbon-dioxide.zh: 森林从空气中吸收大量二氧化碳。

methane.en: Cattle release large quantities of methane into the atmosphere each year.
methane.zh: 牛每年向大气释放大量甲烷。

emission.en: The agreement commits countries to cutting their carbon emissions by half.
emission.zh: 这项协议要求各国把碳排放量削减一半。

ice-age.en: Sea levels were much lower during the last ice age.
ice-age.zh: 上一个冰河时代的海平面要低得多。

sea-level.en: Large parts of the Netherlands lie below sea level and are protected by walls.
sea-level.zh: 荷兰大片地区低于海平面,靠堤坝保护。

climatic.en: Climatic changes may have forced early people to leave the region.
climatic.zh: 气候变化可能迫使早期的人们离开这一地区。

drizzle.en: Light drizzle falls on most days during the winter months.
drizzle.zh: 冬季大部分日子都会下毛毛雨。

shower.en: Spring showers help the young crops to grow strongly.
shower.zh: 春季阵雨有助于幼苗茁壮成长。

downpour.en: A sudden downpour turned the dry riverbed into a fast-moving stream.
downpour.zh: 一场突如其来的倾盆大雨把干涸的河床变成了湍急的溪流。

torrential.en: Torrential rain caused landslides that blocked the main road.
torrential.zh: 暴雨引发滑坡,堵塞了主干道。

gale.en: Fishing boats stayed in port because of a severe gale at sea.
gale.zh: 海上刮起强烈的大风,渔船都留在了港口。

whirlwind.en: A whirlwind lifted sand high into the air above the desert.
whirlwind.zh: 一股旋风把沙子卷到沙漠上空。

haze.en: A thick haze from forest fires covered the city for weeks.
haze.zh: 森林大火产生的浓霾笼罩了这座城市数周。

dew.en: Some desert insects collect dew from their bodies to drink.
dew.zh: 一些沙漠昆虫收集身上的露水来饮用。

damp.en: Damp conditions in the cave caused the old paintings to fade.
damp.zh: 洞穴里的潮湿环境使古老的壁画褪色了。

chilly.en: The mountain air becomes chilly as soon as the sun goes down.
chilly.zh: 太阳一落山,山里的空气就变得寒冷。

balmy.en: The island's balmy weather makes it a popular destination in winter.
balmy.zh: 这座岛气候温和宜人,是冬季热门的旅游目的地。

torrid.en: Few people could work outside in the torrid heat of the summer.
torrid.zh: 在夏季的酷热中,很少有人能在户外工作。

windward.en: Most of the rain falls on the windward side of the mountains.
windward.zh: 大部分雨水落在山脉的迎风面。

barometer.en: A falling barometer is often a sign that a storm is coming.
barometer.zh: 气压计读数下降往往是风暴来临的征兆。

troposphere.en: Almost all of the Earth's weather occurs in the troposphere.
troposphere.zh: 地球上几乎所有的天气现象都发生在对流层。

turbulent.en: The turbulent water at the foot of the falls is too dangerous for boats.
turbulent.zh: 瀑布脚下的湍急水流对船只来说太危险了。

turbulent.en: The country went through a turbulent period after the king's death.
turbulent.zh: 国王去世后,这个国家经历了一段动荡时期。

inversion.en: A temperature inversion can trap pollution close to the ground for days.
inversion.zh: 逆温现象可能把污染物困在近地面达数日之久。

aerosol.en: Aerosols from burning coal reflect some sunlight back into space.
aerosol.zh: 燃煤产生的气溶胶把部分阳光反射回太空。

chill.en: A sudden chill in the air warned the farmers that winter was near.
chill.zh: 空气中突然的寒意提醒农民,冬天快到了。

marine.en: Plastic waste poses a growing danger to marine animals of all sizes.
marine.zh: 塑料垃圾对各种大小的海洋动物构成日益严重的威胁。

coral-reef.en: The coral reef provides food and shelter for thousands of species.
coral-reef.zh: 珊瑚礁为数千个物种提供食物和庇护。

plankton.en: Many whales feed on tiny plankton that float near the surface.
plankton.zh: 许多鲸以漂浮在海面附近的微小浮游生物为食。

algae.en: Warm water and pollution can cause algae to spread rapidly across the lake.
algae.zh: 温暖的水和污染可能导致藻类在湖面迅速蔓延。

seaweed.en: In parts of Asia, seaweed has long been an important source of food.
seaweed.zh: 在亚洲部分地区,海藻长期以来一直是重要的食物来源。

whale.en: The blue whale is the largest animal that has ever lived.
whale.zh: 蓝鲸是有史以来最大的动物。

dolphin.en: Dolphins use a range of sounds to communicate within their groups.
dolphin.zh: 海豚用多种声音在群体内交流。

shark.en: Although people fear them, few species of shark are dangerous to humans.
shark.zh: 尽管人们害怕鲨鱼,但对人类有危险的鲨鱼种类很少。

seal.en: Seals come onto the beaches here to give birth in the autumn.
seal.zh: 海豹秋天来到这里的海滩产崽。

seal.en: The jars were sealed with wax to keep the food fresh.
seal.zh: 这些罐子用蜡密封,以保持食物新鲜。

jellyfish.en: Warmer seas have led to a large increase in the number of jellyfish.
jellyfish.zh: 海水变暖导致水母数量大幅增加。

octopus.en: An octopus can change its colour to hide from its enemies.
octopus.zh: 章鱼能改变体色来躲避天敌。

squid.en: Giant squid live so deep that they are rarely seen by humans.
squid.zh: 巨型鱿鱼生活在极深的海域,人类很少见到。

oyster.en: Oysters help to keep the water clean by filtering out small particles.
oyster.zh: 牡蛎通过滤除微小颗粒来帮助保持水质清洁。

crustacean.en: Crabs and lobsters belong to a group of animals called crustaceans.
crustacean.zh: 螃蟹和龙虾属于一类被称为甲壳动物的动物。

shellfish.en: Fishing for shellfish has been banned because of pollution in the bay.
shellfish.zh: 由于海湾受到污染,捕捞贝类已被禁止。

tide.en: Twice a day, the rising tide covers the sand and the rocks.
tide.zh: 每天两次,上涨的潮水淹没沙滩和岩石。

tidal.en: Tidal power could provide a reliable source of clean electricity.
tidal.zh: 潮汐能可以提供可靠的清洁电力来源。

tsunami.en: The tsunami was caused by a powerful earthquake under the ocean.
tsunami.zh: 这场海啸是由海底强烈地震引发的。

seabed.en: Large parts of the seabed have never been properly explored.
seabed.zh: 大部分海床从未被好好探索过。

trench.en: The deepest known trench in the ocean is almost eleven kilometres deep.
trench.zh: 已知最深的海沟深度近十一公里。

salinity.en: The salinity of the sea varies with temperature and rainfall.
salinity.zh: 海水的盐度随温度和降雨量变化。

overfishing.en: Overfishing has greatly reduced the number of cod in the North Sea.
overfishing.zh: 过度捕捞使北海的鳕鱼数量大幅减少。

acidification.en: Ocean acidification makes it harder for shellfish to build their shells.
acidification.zh: 海洋酸化使贝类更难形成外壳。

submarine.en: Scientists used a small submarine to study life on the ocean floor.
submarine.zh: 科学家用一艘小型潜艇研究海底生物。

sonar.en: Ships use sonar to measure the depth of the water beneath them.
sonar.zh: 船只用声呐测量船下的水深。

starfish.en: A starfish can grow a new arm if one is damaged.
starfish.zh: 海星的腕受损后能再长出一条新的。

porpoise.en: The porpoise is smaller than most dolphins and has a shorter nose.
porpoise.zh: 鼠海豚比大多数海豚小,吻部也更短。

prawn.en: Coastal forests have been cleared to make way for prawn farms.
prawn.zh: 沿海森林被砍伐,为对虾养殖场腾出空间。

shrimp.en: Tiny shrimp are an important part of the diet of many whales.
shrimp.zh: 小虾是许多鲸鱼食物的重要组成部分。

lobster.en: A lobster sheds its hard shell several times as it grows larger.
lobster.zh: 龙虾在长大过程中会多次蜕去坚硬的外壳。

crab.en: The crab carries its eggs under its body until they are ready to hatch.
crab.zh: 螃蟹把卵带在身体下面,直到它们快要孵化。

clam.en: A giant clam can live for more than a hundred years.

mussel.en: Mussels attach themselves firmly to rocks to avoid being washed away.
mussel.zh: 贻贝牢牢附着在岩石上,以免被冲走。

sponge.en: A sponge feeds by drawing water through small holes in its body.
sponge.zh: 海绵通过身上的小孔吸水来获取食物。

coral.en: Rising temperatures have caused large areas of coral to turn white and die.
coral.zh: 气温上升导致大片珊瑚变白死亡。

pearl.en: A pearl forms when an oyster covers a small object with layers of shell.
pearl.zh: 牡蛎用一层层贝壳物质包裹小物体时,就形成了珍珠。

ebb.en: Boats can leave the harbour only when the tide begins to ebb.
ebb.zh: 只有潮水开始退去时,船只才能离开港口。

nautical.en: Portuguese sailors produced some of the most accurate nautical charts of the time.
nautical.zh: 葡萄牙水手绘制了当时最精确的一些航海图。

seaport.en: The town grew rapidly into an important seaport during the 1700s.
seaport.zh: 18 世纪,这座城镇迅速发展成重要的海港。

drift.en: Over millions of years, the continents have slowly drifted apart.
drift.zh: 数百万年间,各大洲慢慢漂移分开。

shallow.en: Young fish stay in shallow water where they are safer from predators.
shallow.zh: 幼鱼待在浅水区,那里更不容易受到捕食者的攻击。
